name: craft_loop_flow
description: The agentic craft loop: act (any registered engine command — a comfyui graph or an mcp:blender tool call) -> capture (artifacts land in the run dir) -> critique (a named image-capable model route sees the capture itself) -> decide (done, or refine with the next act command). Bounded by max_iterations (default unlimited, hard cap 1000). Drive it by starting a run with an engine 'craft' stage: params carry agent_prompt (the brief), inputs.command (the first act: {engine, params}), optional model (the critic route id, when the loop card names one) and max_iterations.

agent_prompt.description: The brief the critic holds the captures against.

inputs.description: Generic input map; must carry command: {engine, params} — the first act.

model.description: Optional critic route id (image-capable; the boot-resolved route serves otherwise).

max_iterations.description: Optional iteration bound (default unlimited; hard cap 1000).
